milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the blue terracotta structure and face it, confirming they have visually located it. The target is the center of the blue terracotta pillar at spawn-relative (7, 2, 5). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.
